classification.difficultyReason: Use supplied nets and named face groups to select triangle or rectangle dimensions, calculate their areas and add; distinguish triangular height from sloping side length.

content.prompt: Calculate the surface area of these prisms.

spec.description: Rectangular prism with front width 8 cm, height 5 cm and depth 3 cm. Front, top and right faces are visible; the three edges meeting at the rear lower left vertex are dashed. Decorative grey shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: Six rectangular faces: two 8 by 5, two 3 by 5 and two 8 by 3.

spec.description: Connected net with Back, Bottom, Front and Top in a vertical strip. Both side flaps attach to Bottom. All repeated source measurements retained. Decorative shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: Strip width 8 cm; successive heights from top are 5, 3, 5 and 3 cm. Side flaps are 5 by 3 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Face labels and measurements are permanent givens.

answer.worked:
Front and back: $(5\times8)\times2=80\text{ cm}^{2}$.

Sides: $(3\times5)\times2=30\text{ cm}^{2}$.

Bottom and top: $(3\times8)\times2=48\text{ cm}^{2}$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total surface area}&=80+30+48\\&=158\text{ cm}^{2}.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Rectangular prism with front width 3 cm, height 2 cm and receding length 5 cm. Visible front, top and right face boundaries retained; source does not show hidden edges. Dimension arrows retained. Decorative top shading omitted.
spec.mathematics: Face pairs have areas 3 times 2, 5 times 2 and 3 times 5 square centimetres.

spec.description: Source face names retained: top, back, bottom, front in the vertical strip, with side on both flaps. Repeated equality ticks and dimension arrows retained. Decorative shading omitted. Face names conflict with the supplied scaffold orientation.
spec.mathematics: Strip width 5 cm with heights 3, 2, 3 and 2 cm from top to bottom; flaps are 2 by 3 cm. All six faces form a connected net of the same rectangular prism.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements, equality ticks and original face names are permanent givens.

answer.worked:
Using the face orientation of the solid:

Front and back: $(3\times2)\times2=12\text{ cm}^{2}$.

Sides: $(5\times2)\times2=20\text{ cm}^{2}$.

Bottom and top: $(3\times5)\times2=30\text{ cm}^{2}$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Total surface area}&=12+20+30\\&=62\text{ cm}^{2}.\end{align*}$$
